messages:
anya: FYI PR #452 is blocked by premerge scans — SAST flagged a 'hardcoded-credential' in infra/keystore.go line 38 but this is a test fixture.
scan-bot: [auto] SAST report: HIGH hardcoded-credential infra/keystore.go:38 (rule: CRED_LIT). Full output attached to build artifacts.
ci-bot: premerge checks failed: sast, dast. See job #build-452.
sam: Can we short-circuit this with a targeted suppression? It's definitely a false positive from the test key.
leo: We try to avoid ad-hoc suppressions. If it truly is a FP we need owner ack + evidence + a short-lived suppression policy.
anya: I added a note in the PR explaining why it's test-only and pasted the stack/log excerpt. Here's the offending snippet:
```go
// test fixture for key rotation tests - not a real secret
var testKey = "TEST-KEY-DO-NOT-USE"
```
maria: That exact pattern trips CRED_LIT. Two proposals: (A) add a file-level exception for test fixtures, or (B) update scanner severity for this specific rule when under `test/` paths.
leo: (B) is safer if we scope path correctly. We can add a `severity_override` in scanners.yaml for `CRED_LIT` => info for regex `^infra/test/` paths, but that requires central scanner service change + security approval.
sec-oncall: Short answer: temporary allowance OK but we need a ticket with evidence and an expiry. Create a JIRA (RES-321) and add the PR link + sanitized logs. We'll approve a 14-day suppression with audits. Also add a unit test that asserts no real secrets.
anya: Question about evidence storage — can I attach failing logs to the ticket? We need to keep them encrypted.
sam: Use the `s3://redwood-scan-evidence` bucket with SSE-KMS using key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/prod-scan-evidence. Grant the CI role `ci-uploader` PutObject and KMS Encrypt. Do NOT give broad Decrypt to CI.
maria: For future: it would help if the scanner also uploaded a minimal JSON evidence blob with rule, path, snippet (sanitized) and a digest. That can be uploaded by CI with server-side encryption.
leo: Agree. We should also attach an evidence link in the JIRA and keep a short rationale template: what was detected, why FP, owner, and mitigation plan.
scan-bot: suppression-request created: SR-2187 (expiry: 2026-04-04). Link: https://tools.redwood/internal/sr/SR-2187
sam: I'll open the JIRA RES-321 and attach the encrypted logs. I'll also add the unit test and drop a TODO to refactor the fixture.
sec-oncall: Reminder: if a future release introduces a real key, the unit test must fail CI. Also flag for monthly noise review so we don't accumulate exemptions.
anya: Done — RES-321 created, attached artifact (encrypted), PR comment updated with SR-2187. Leaving this thread open until infra refactor PR is merged.
maria: Small follow-up: can we add a scanner config lint check to prevent blanket `exclude: infra/**` style suppressions? Too many teams have abused that pattern.
leo: Good call. I'll add a pre-merge lint rule to the central scanner runner that rejects broad excludes and requires path-scoped patterns with owner metadata.
sam: Thanks all — I'll take the action items: file infra refactor issue, attach tests, and reference RES-321 in the release notes.
anya: Closing loop later — will post status when refactor PR lands. :thumbsup:
